problems.problem: The reading attaches to the wrong promise: the plain sense ends on God promising Abraham ‘nations and land’, so ‘reads the promise as God uniting His name with...’ lands on nations and land, whereas Sforno’s comment is on the lemma להיות לך לאלהים ולזרעך אחריך, the promise to be their God. ‘Uniting His name with’ also softens ליחד שמי עליכם, God binding His name upon them.
problems.fix: Point the reading at its lemma with at most three words of the key verse, e.g. ‘Sforno, on Genesis 17:7, reads ‘a God unto thee’ as God binding His name to Abraham and his descendants without intermediary, so that, keeping the covenant, they endure for ever.’ (re-run entry-check for the count).

problems.problem: Rule 9: src names no edition actually read, only the export commit; the packet gives Sforno’s Hebrew as “On Your Way”, and d014 was corrected for exactly this omission, so the batch is inconsistent.
problems.fix: src: ‘Sforno, Commentary on the Torah, Genesis 17:7, Hebrew (On Your Way), Sefaria export commit 3f10136 (2026)’.

problems.problem: Prose: ‘this one opens the command on the seventh day’ reads as a command given on the seventh day rather than the command concerning it; a reader at six in the morning can take it the wrong way.
problems.fix: ‘this one opens the command about the seventh day’ (or ‘concerning the seventh day’); nothing else changes.
